probe_result: 34 probes: 30 pass (contract pins), 4 fail (defect evidence: F-LC-1 x3, F-LC-2 x1)

findings.title: tribulation.cooldownUntil is unbounded - a crafted save wedges tribulation start() forever
findings.detail: validateGameSaveShape accepts any non-negative finite tribulation.cooldownUntil (src/services/save/saveShapeValidation.ts ~3676: isNonNegativeFiniteNumber only). TribulationDirector.restoreRuntime restores it verbatim (src/core/tribulation/TribulationDirector.ts ~799: this.cooldownUntil = slice?.cooldownUntil ?? 0). start() refuses whenever getCooldownSeconds() > 0 (line ~217), and getCooldownSeconds = ceil((cooldownUntil - now)/1000). A hostile-but-shape-valid save carrying cooldownUntil = 9e15 yields ~8.99e12 seconds of cooldown - a permanent progression deadlock on the qi_refining -> foundation_establishment transition (the only forward path). The honest writer only ever stamps Date.now() + TRIBULATION_COOLDOWN_SECONDS*1000 (300s), so a bound cooldownUntil <= lastSavedAt + 300_000 is provable at the same validation site - the same provable-forgery class already bounded for alchemy job spans (F-A12-4) and building levels (F-A8-2).
findings.repro: tests/architecture/betaLocalCorrectnessAudit.qa.test.ts > 'F-LC-1a' validateGameSaveShape({...mortalSave(), tribulation:{cooldownUntil:9e15}}).ok === true (expected false); 'F-LC-1b' director.restoreRuntime({cooldownUntil:9e15}) -> getCooldownSeconds() ~ 8.99e12 >> 300; 'F-LC-1c' director.start(eligible qi_refining player, stats, false, 'foundation_establishment') === false under the forged cooldown
findings.fix_direction: Bound cooldownUntil at validation (<= lastSavedAt + TRIBULATION_COOLDOWN_SECONDS*1000) and/or clamp at restoreRuntime; both are inside existing anti-forgery conventions.

findings.title: betaSupportedFor/unsupportedReleaseReason player-only seams cannot classify slice-owned dormant records
findings.detail: unsupportedReleaseReason(player, saveSlices) reads saveSlices.alchemyJobs and saveSlices.decompose for 'dormant_alchemy_job' and 'dormant_decompose_state'. The facade wrappers on GameManagerProgressionOps (lines 1178-1184: betaSupportedFor/unsupportedReleaseReason) and the domain betaSupportedFor(player) take no slices, so a save whose ONLY out-of-scope state is a dormant alchemy job or a live decompose station reports supported through those seams. Zero consumers today (the live boot path useAppLifecycle.ts:467 calls the domain function WITH slices), so this is a dead-API footgun rather than a live misclassification.
findings.repro: tests/architecture/betaLocalCorrectnessAudit.qa.test.ts > 'F-LC-2': unsupportedReleaseReason(player, {alchemyJobs:[{recipeId:'alchemy_duong_than_dan_qi_refining'}]}) === 'dormant_alchemy_job' while betaSupportedFor(player) === true on the same player
findings.fix_direction: Drop the slice-blind facade wrappers, or extend them to take BetaUnsupportedSaveSlices; dead API should not carry a save-level claim.
